name: Los Angeles County Fire Department Explorer Program
what_you_do: Explorers learn what firefighting takes. They build leadership and discipline and do community service. They meet twice a month at their post and go on monthly ride-alongs. They also join yearly trainings and drills.
who_can_apply: Ages 15 to 20 with at least a 2.0 GPA. You can read, write and understand training materials in English. You can work on a team. You must pass a doctor's physical.
pay_detail: No pay is stated. The 2026 recruitment slides list about $75 for a fitness uniform and an $85 yearly Learning for Life fee. The department covers the work uniform, boots and safety gear. Banquet costs may be extra.
duration: Ongoing after a two-day orientation; twice-monthly meetings
deadline_text: Open enrollment is usually held once a year in May. The 2026 window was May 16, 2026 at 9 a.m. to May 18, 2026 at 5 p.m., online only and first come, first served, with about 150 spots. Exact 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Send in the Explorer Program Interest Card to hear about the next cycle. Add the program's email to your safe senders. Then apply online during open enrollment. In 2026 the form asked for a 250-word response. Accepted applicants get a uniform fitting and a family meeting. They also go to a two-day orientation.
notes: Dates and costs are from the 2026 recruitment slides linked on the page, so 2027 may differ. The page lists 12 posts. They are Vernon, Carson, Whittier, Industry, Azusa, Lancaster, Fairfax, Santa Clarita, La Canada Flintridge, El Monte, Agoura Hills and Pomona. But its sign-up form lists Posts 1 to 22. Confirm your post with the department.
